create_logger_instance: create a Logger instance that writes output to both terminal and a log file at a given path
create_logger_append_mode: create a Logger instance in append mode to add to an existing log file without overwriting
write_log_message: write a message to both the terminal and the log file using the Logger write method
review_logger_class: review the Logger class that duplicates stdout to a file with write and flush methods
test_logger_flush: test the Logger flush method to ensure Python 3 compatibility with no-op behavior
